items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Special Edition. This one has new personnel. Baikida Carroll on trumpet... [INTERVIEWEE] Right, then I think we come back to Special Edition later.

ctx.x: From BAG, Black Artists Group? Lester, Julius Hemphill...
Yeah, Baikida Carroll and also although he wasn't a part of it, David Sanborn was from St. Louis also. Julius was a genius but anyway we'll talk about that later, too.
So, you were still there, let's say, 1965, 1964. So Roscoe… …Delmark records, he's already starting to record. That's where I heard Robert Crowder and Roscoe Mitchell's quartet.
